verdict.rationale: Meltano documents loaders as a core plugin type and claims a library of 600+ connectors that move data 'from any source to any destination,' so destination portability is plausibly first-party. However, the evidence never names a loader for Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Postgres, or object storage, and never shows swapping loaders without editing pipelines. Missing for 10: named loaders for Snowflake/BigQuery/Databricks/Postgres/object storage, documentation of swapping destinations without pipeline changes, hands-on corroboration of multi-warehouse loading.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I load to the major warehouses and lakes — Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Postgres, object storage — without changing pipelines

citations.quote: your project and pipelines are composed of plugins of different types, most notably extractors, loaders, utilities
